translations.web: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
translations.bsb: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.”
translations.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
translations.asv: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.
